method.comparison: Type-aware equality for eq; numeric <= for lte.
method.composition: all_of: false dominates, otherwise unknown unless all true. any_of: conjunction within each alternative, true alternative dominates, otherwise unknown unless all alternatives false.
method.consultation_of_authored_expected: Compared only after independent raw-fact calculation.
method.eligibility: Matching fact key; active status; required scope keys equal snapshot target; observed age from 0 to max_age_minutes inclusive; select uniquely newest eligible observation. Missing or tied newest yields unknown.

read_limits: Only manifest and protocol read; no participant answers, calibration, coder outputs, existing reference-review calculation, task/scorer implementation, or live reference output read.
reviewer: /root/followup_live_audit/reference_check; separate AI agent in the same orchestration, not external human validation
